title: LP Copilot
tagline: An AI liquidity copilot powered by Privy wallets, Uniswap, and The Graph.
description: LP Copilot helps users understand and manage liquidity through a conversational AI assistant. Privy provides the wallet and transaction approvals, Uniswap powers liquidity positions and adjustments, and The Graph supplies indexed onchain data for monitoring and AI analysis. Users can explore price ranges, track positions, and approve a bounded adjustment plan. The current prototype runs on Base Sepolia, with both manual operations and delegated execution tested onchain.
how_its_made:
Privy: Embedded wallets handle login and user-approved transactions. Temporary delegated signers let an approved plan execute within token, recipient, chain, and expiry limits; the server additionally checks the exact transaction and range.

Uniswap: The SDK and deployed contracts support position math, adding or removing liquidity, collecting tokens, and repositioning into a new range.

The Graph: A custom subgraph indexes pool events. We cross-check indexed data against RPC for freshness and consistency before using it in position monitoring and AI assessments.

React, Node.js, and SQLite connect the interface, monitoring, and execution history. DeepSeek powers the conversational assistant. Development was AI-assisted, with human product direction and testing.
auto_summary: A web app and backend that helps users monitor and manage Uniswap liquidity positions with AI, Privy wallets, and The Graph-backed data checks.
